findings.body:
Production binds WORKER_AGENTS, so every worker attempt takes startHostedAttempt. hostedBoot forces harness pi-durable, the agent is started on model 'sonnet', no claudeSub interception is installed, and the container env carries TICKS_CLAUDE_SUB=1 with TICKS_HARNESS=pi-durable, which image/common.sh dies on. The handle names pi-durable/sonnet, which the Go executor refuses under CloudBillingAllows. The lease taken in deps.boot is never released (no collect follows a refused start), so it holds a cap slot until the 2h TTL. Every claude-sub door test sets WORKER_AGENTS undefined, so this path is untested. Fix: route a subscription-rung attempt to a worker that runs the claude CLI under the interception, or make the agent host it. Add a test with WORKER_AGENTS bound that the Go executor accepts end to end.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts:715 and :959 hostedBoot; cloudflare/src/worker-agent.ts:215; image/common.sh:229; cloudflare/test/sandbox-dispatch.test.ts:367; Go repro: fake door bootedHarness=WorkerAgentHarness on a claude/sonnet start -> 'running on pi-durable/sonnet, which the cloud billing rule refuses'
findings.title: Hosted WorkerAgent door ignores the claude-sub rung; every rung job dies

findings.body:
When no subscription is free, the door boots the deployment's standing pair and returns pi-durable / workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3. cloudflaresandbox.Executor.Start refuses any handle whose model is not the requested one ('sonnet'), so the [A1] fallback can never start a worker. CloudRule.SubscriptionRungs[].Fallback is read only by a test, and it is spelled cloudflare-workers-ai/... while the factory steps down to RUN_WORKER_MODEL (workers-ai/...). Fix: when the request is a subscription-rung pair, accept exactly the rung's declared fallback pair (namespace-normalised), record the pair that ran, and test that both sides agree.
evidence: internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/executor.go:445; repro: newExecutorOnRung(claude, sonnet) with door.bootedModel=workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3, bootedHarness=pi-durable -> 'the door booted attempt 1 ... on model "workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3", not the "sonnet" its dispatch resolved'
findings.title: Go executor refuses the factory's Workers AI step-down of a rung dispatch

findings.body:
6fv's title promises a current claude CLI in the image, and the operator's note on tda says the aliases resolve to 5.5 today. CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION is still 2.1.227, which maps opus to claude-opus-5 and sonnet to claude-sonnet-5. The weekly workflow only proposes a bump later.
evidence: image/Dockerfile:53 ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.227; docs/spikes/jvj-claude-sub-cloud.md design item 1
findings.title: Image still pins claude CLI 2.1.227: opus/sonnet resolve to 5, not 5.5

findings.body:
Each run makes a fresh commit on chore/claude-cli-pin-<ver> and runs a plain git push -u. If last week's PR for the same version is still open, the remote branch exists with a different commit, so the push is rejected as non-fast-forward and the job goes red before the 'already open' check runs.
evidence: .github/workflows/claude-cli-pin.yml 'Open the bump PR' step
findings.title: claude-cli-pin workflow fails on re-run while its bump PR is open

findings.body:
The worker door's step-down is a console.log in claudeSubLeaseForBoot. Spike jvj asked the run feed to say 'claude-sub exhausted until <reset>; on Workers AI'. Without that line, a claude-config run that quietly ran on GLM reads as a claude run in status and watch.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts claudeSubLeaseForBoot
findings.title: Write a claude-sub step-down to the run feed, not only the Worker console
